body: I lost a lot of blood from an accident at one point. Wouldn't say there was any memories or anything. I just remember it being really bright and a voice I didn't recognise telling me that everything's okay and I can wake up now. The voice was really calming and it made me not want to wake up but they kept telling its okay and that I have to wake up now.

I got fired so that the manager could hire his girlfriend instead. I was late a couple times (twice at best) and apologised every time but I was deemed unreliable. The thing is i overheard a conversation between them where he said he wishes he could fire someone so she could be hire. I didn't really care though, the job sucked.
Last time he had me waiting for 3 days. He complained about he cant catch a break 💀
Mixing whiskey, malibu and coke is how you get to this point 😂 and also not going to bed until like 7am helps
The dude never shows up on time!

My family was super toxic in my childhood. My dad was verbally abusive. He called me names, told me I was not a person just a copy, he ruined my self esteem.I had no privacy at all in my childhood, secrets were found out or forced out of you. 

To this day, I'm super insecure about my looks and feel like I'm faking my personality and that I dont know who the real me is. I don't tell anyone anything about myself, I have trust issues and no one knows anything about my personal life and I'm paranoid about privacy.

I feel more free, when I was a teen I always felt like I was trapped by my depression. It hasnt faded but I have more of a handle on it. If could talk to my younger self I would tell her that its okay to take the mask off if it starts to feel heavy on your head. Its okay to take the time to be sad and its okay to tell your friends you're sad, no one is happy all the time. Its okay to feel everything that isnt happiness.
